exposure: Time between birth and placental delivery
cohort: 154 women with IPPH and 308 controls who gave birth at the Maternity Department of the Western French Guiana Hospital over a one-year period
finding: The incidence of IPPH in western French Guiana is similar to that in metropolitan France, with identified risk factors including a past history of IPPH, pre-eclampsia, labor induction by oxytocin, the absence of managed placental delivery, a prolonged interval between birth and placental delivery, and macrosomia.
